what: Each time the pointer enters, one of the fill candidates (default accent color, text color) is picked at random and applied to --fx-tint. Even the same black button has an arrow cell that is orange one time and teal the next. Movement is handled by other motion parts (arrow-pass-hover slide type and so on), and this part only picks the color.

options.pick: Candidate variable names separated by commas, default --kf-accent, --kf-ink (site-specific colors are variables that site builds from --kf-*, like --site-teal)
options.--fx-tint: Value used for the child fill (css) — var(--kf-accent) before the script runs

use: Your button text here→→
note: On touch devices it picks on press. The original uses Math.random() in jQuery mouseenter > .5 attaches one of two classes

from.where: shared.css .s-btn — when the arrow cell of the black button enters from the left, one of orange or teal
